AUDIT GPT-6.1 Sol — growth-project-mobile#362 @ b3bc0ce4d7e62763671881e6babd60aa518203cc — VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

A/B/C = 0/2/1

Independent T4 lens: AUD-SOL-H46-119, agent 119. Full 27-path H4 diff and the integrated H6 consumers were read; the old tests pass, but two asynchronous boundaries remain unsafe. [Candidate and fix round](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5983281769).

### Prior findings first

**B-362-1, B-362-3 and B-362-4 close** for the reported raw-error, held-native-page and real-parent empty-import cases: fixed-class logging, synchronous health stop before cleanup, and retained empty-import guidance are implemented by `a63e1aac`; no-session retirement is completed by `b3bc0ce4`. **B-362-2 is only partially closed**: the old deferred-server-response/account-switch case passes, but cleanup still deletes newer grants in the windows below. [Repair record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5983281769), [17 failing-before / 48 passing controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37223683422/job/111498887453), [no-session failing-before](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37225682321/job/111504719469), [independent exact-top replay](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229474471/job/111515916079).

Opus's empty-import and missing-Try-again Bs are also implemented: real-parent iPhone/Android tests and Health-screen settings-return tests pass, and Samsung rows now use Health Connect authority/copy; this does not imply closure of the two findings below. [Shared repair](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5983281769), [executed controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229474471/job/111515916079).

### B-362-2 — Still open: authorization retirement is check-then-act across storage awaits

**File:line:** `src/services/health/onDeviceState.ts:158-168`; `src/hooks/useWearableConnections.ts:168-181` (no-session fallback). The new scoped cleanup compares `grantedAt`, then awaits `getAllKeys`, then deletes the authorization without checking whether it changed; the all-account fallback likewise continues deleting after an auth-generation change, with only its logging/invalidation fenced. [Exact-head repair](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5983281769).

**Counterexamples:** (1) retire A's old consent, hold key enumeration after the comparison, record A's newer `conn-new` grant, release enumeration: the newer grant is null; (2) start a current no-readable-session Disconnect, hold its enumeration, log B in and write B's `new-b` consent, release: B's new grant is null. Both no-reconnect/no-switch controls pass, so this is not a fixture/setup failure or an objection to the operator's stable-session all-account default. [Two failing invariants and paired passing controls](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229474471/job/111515916079).

**Minimal fix rule:** conditional retirement and local consent writes need one linearized ownership/consent-epoch boundary, covering all their storage awaits. An old cleanup must never remove a newer authorization or its progress; an all-account fallback must not continue destructively into a newer session. Preserve the stable no-session source-retirement behavior and stale-operation own-scope cleanup. Verify both deferred-enumeration invariants with their controls, plus the old held-response probes.

### B-362-6 — New: the session fence is checked only after a new-session DELETE is already sent

**File:line:** `src/hooks/useWearableConnections.ts:150-156`. Generation is captured before reading identity/local consent, but neither awaited read is followed by a current-session check before `wearablesConnectionsApi.disconnect(provider)`; the first generation comparison is at line 161, too late to prevent the request. [Exact-head repair](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5983281769).

**Counterexamples:** hold A's identity read or local-authorization read, sign B in, then release the old read: both cases still invoke Disconnect once (expected zero); their unchanged-session controls invoke it normally. A second test composes the **real hook → real provider API → real Axios token interceptor → synthetic adapter**: after switching to B's synthetic token, A's delayed action reaches `/v1/wearables/connections/HEALTH_CONNECT` with Authorization (masked by Actions), instead of no dispatch; the stable-session control receives A's expected token and passes. No live request or actual token is involved; the backend selects the disconnected account from JWT, not a captured user id. [Two failing capture invariants](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229474471/job/111515916079), [real-interceptor transport proof: 5 invariant failures / 46 passing tests](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229689090/job/111516560884), [backend source](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-backend/commit/3e9a9a75f8ec2071526555af068e7fad36cd09e6).

**Minimal fix rule:** bind the mutation to the originating session and fail closed after every pre-request await, before issuing DELETE, including token attachment/retry boundaries. A stale action must not send a destructive request under a replacement session or publish success/error/refetch/reporting on that session. Keep unchanged-session Disconnect working; add the two held-capture regressions and a real-token-interceptor/synthetic-adapter assertion.

### C-362-5 — Retained optional follow-up: resting-heart-rate-only state/recovery

`src/screens/client/wearables/HealthFitnessScreen.tsx:147-156,207-209,265-287,312-318`: RHR uses a separate query, but the overview's meaningful-data, loading/error and pull-to-refresh state still depend solely on the primary query; RHR-only results are hidden by the empty return and secondary failures are not retried. [Prior C-362-5](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5982471782).

Fix rule: include RHR in meaningful-data detection, bounded secondary loading/error/stale presentation and refresh; add RHR-only and secondary-error controls. Ticket separately under the freeze.

### Evidence applicability, execution and landing limits

G09: 15 of 27 H4 diff-path blobs remain identical to this model's original APPROVE `82137c31`; reuse is limited to those unchanged blobs and their scoped prior closures. All full-piece paths and all changes since that approval were read, not inferred from another model's verdict. Every H4 changed-path blob also matches the H6 top `529ba345`, so exact-top probe results apply to the H4 implementation/dependencies; blob tables and probe source are saved in `ops/aud-119/AUD-SOL-H46-119/`. [Original Sol approval](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/317#issuecomment-5972055787), [integrated top repair](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/364#issuecomment-5983281999).

The independent execution contains the exact H6 candidate plus tests and the lane harness only: **4 failed / 207 passed tests, 11 passing suites / 1 failing suite**, including old Sol H4 5/5 disconnect probes, 2/2 actual-parent probes, adapted H6 retirement 5/5 and platform/contract controls. The Samsung adaptation changes only the old expected wire identifier to canonical HEALTH_CONNECT; the prior verdict explicitly permitted that UX adaptation. Act warnings are retained and do not account for these named assertion failures. [Executed independent lane](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37229474471/job/111515916079), [prior adaptation rule](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/364#issuecomment-5982566404).

Exact-head Typecheck/lint/test is green; the independent lane is intentionally red for proven invariants, not a PR CI regression. Both Analyze checks are absent on the stacked base and still required at main-based landing. Size is **2,835**, grandfathered under 3,000; only 165 lines of headroom remain. [PR CI](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/actions/runs/37225736086/job/111504878588), [size/fix record](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5983281769).

Default operator action: one H4 repair round for B-362-2/B-362-6, place additional tests in H5 or a bounded test piece rather than exceeding H4/H6 caps, replay both lenses, restack H5/H6 and obtain fresh exact-head deltas. H1–H6 still land as one; ingest and AI insights remain off until their separate approved release sequence, with truthful consent-copy follow-ups, native/device and Play-policy/declaration gates outstanding. [Stack rule](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/362#issuecomment-5975773360), [pre-release limits](https://github.com/BradleyGleavePortfolio/growth-project-mobile/pull/364#issuecomment-5983281999).
